changes.comment: Indexed selection on the task repository: query, queryDue and listOwed answered from resident indexes kept current on every commit (no record reads), with scope unions deduplicated before paging, lifecycle class/status selection, parent and responsibility filters, due candidates ordered by notBefore, and owed updates listed per subscription independent of lifecycle. Server-held keyset cursors bound to the normalized query and generation; archive keeps identity, edges and source binding resident; lookupSource and source-binding uniqueness; staged rebuildIndexes shared with open, fencing on a post-commit index failure; bounded read concurrency and an optional parsed-record cache; and runTaskRepositoryConformance for custom repositories.
